final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT crewref AS c1, COUNT(*) AS c2, AVG(gbsize * 1.0 / spanmin) AS c3 FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c3) AS a1 FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1 AS d1, s1.c2 AS d2, s1.c3 AS d3, s1.c3 - s2.a1 AS d4 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a1 IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c3 > s2.a1) SELECT AVG(d2), AVG(d3), AVG(d4) FROM s3
